purpose: Sanitized root control manifest. It is intentionally safe for clean exploration workers to read because substantive role policies are not co-located here.

config_resolution.resolution_rule: After reading this root manifest, resolve only the config destination appropriate to the current bootstrap role. Clean exploration workers must read only their own role-local config path and must never read DOWNSTREAM_STATE.json, O_OPERATIONS.json, another role config, another receipt namespace, or the shared aggregate ledger. Non-exploration managed roles resolve their exact role entry from DOWNSTREAM_STATE.json. O operations roles continue to resolve from O_OPERATIONS.json.

global_safe_policy.control_freshness: At run start obtain the latest note main object SHA using a SHA-only Git-ref lookup such as refs/heads/main or an equivalent response that contains no commit message, diff, file snippet, other-role receipt text, or other semantic payload. Fetch this manifest plus the role's designated config at that exact SHA. Before the first substantive semantic read, repeat the SHA-only ref lookup; if control_revision or the role config_revision changed, refetch and restart the pre-semantic bootstrap on the newer tuple. The first role-local/public-source semantic read is a hard semantic-freeze barrier: from that point the selected {main SHA, control revision, config revision, config blob} is immutable for the physical invocation. If control changes after the barrier, do not adopt it, reinterpret results, or continue semantic work under it; checkpoint under the frozen tuple and defer the newer control to the next invocation. If a connector unexpectedly bundles semantic text with a head lookup, quarantine and discard that text before reasoning and use a clean SHA-only ref lookup instead.
global_safe_policy.receipt_chronology: Durable receipts must use actual observed offset-aware timestamps, not rounded filename labels, for invocation_started_at/started_at and checkpointed_at/ended_at/receipt_written_at. Any terminal receipt timestamp must be greater than or equal to the invocation start timestamp. If exact chronology cannot be established, preserve the raw observations and mark chronology_valid=false; never fabricate or backdate a terminal timestamp.

semantic_inputs_forbidden: other clean-worker state or role config
commit messages/diffs/file snippets or other semantic payload obtained only while resolving repository head SHA
clean_exploration_boundary.receipt_rule: write only immutable role-local receipts without reading shared or other-role observability content; each receipt must identify exactly one frozen semantic control/config tuple for the invocation and satisfy global_safe_policy.receipt_chronology
clean_exploration_boundary.feedback_rule: own sanitized feedback is mechanical self-local quality control only and cannot convey novelty, relevance, acceptance/rejection, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge, or other-worker information
clean_exploration_boundary.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology and minimum predecessor chain. Quarantine accidentally opened stale/cross-role observability content and do not use it semantically.
clean_exploration_boundary.scope_guard: never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope
clean_exploration_boundary.head_lookup_transport: For cleanliness/freshness checks use Git ref object lookup only. Do not use generic commit search, commit detail, branch detail, repository search, or any endpoint/tool response that may bundle unrelated commit messages, diffs, file snippets, or receipt bodies merely to learn the head SHA.

migration.reason: Revision 10 adds a sanitized receipt-chronology invariant after repeated role-local receipts showed terminal timestamps earlier than their invocation start because minute-rounded artifact labels were reused as event time. This is observability/provenance hardening only and does not change research direction, evidence scope, or cross-role semantic boundaries.
migration.rollback: Restore DESIRED_STATE blob 2e1f998368a6848e737aa108c838edb4ad355cdb and self_improvement role blob e887cc0b81760e87fc04d80d3e7ee63cc6cb6fe6 only if the chronology invariant prevents a role from preserving raw observed timestamps or safely checkpointing. Preserve SHA-only head transport, semantic freeze, clean independence and exact tested scope on rollback.
